reviews.text: I wanted to express my sincere gratitude because you truly saved me. I am so grateful to this gentleman who brought my dog ​​back. I was walking my dog ​​when I suddenly felt dizzy and fell, letting go of the leash, and my dog ​​ran away. A man passing by on his bicycle came to my rescue. I was panicking because my dog ​​had run away, so he told me to stay here and go look for him, and rode off on his bicycle in the direction my dog ​​had gone, and he brought my dog ​​back with him. I was so relieved and happy that I cried like a child. Not only did he leave his bicycle where he caught my dog ​​and bring him back, but he also managed to find and secure my difficult dog, who doesn't warm up to anyone but me, and bring him back. Even now, when I think about it, I am so moved and impressed. Perhaps he felt relieved when my family arrived, because he left without introducing himself, and I regret not being able to thank him properly, but he said he was affiliated with this place, so I wanted to leave this review. Thank you so much for everything that happened.
The staff were very helpful, and I felt at ease leaving my dog ​​there. Most importantly, my dog ​​came back in a good mood, so I would definitely like to use their services again next time.

I wanted my dog ​​to be a ring dog for my wedding in Shibuya, so I was looking for a hotel that would take care of my dog ​​before and after the ceremony, bring him to the venue when it was time for his appearance, and provide ring dog support. I found a ring dog support listing on their website, so I contacted them. Through email correspondence, they helped me understand my dog's personality and what to be mindful of, the flow of the ceremony, and even the venue's detailed rules, allowing me to approach the day with peace of mind. Although the Shiba dog scattered the rings during the actual ceremony, the ring dog was a great success! They also sent me numerous emails with lots of pictures of how my dog ​​was doing at the hotel, and it seemed like he was having fun playing with the other dogs. Thanks to the customer support staff who communicated with me carefully via email beforehand, the pet sitter who came to support the ring dog on the day, the hotel staff who watched my dog ​​for two nights, and the other dogs who played nicely with my dog ​​at the hotel, I was able to create wonderful memories that will stay with me forever. Thank you so much.

Boarded my elderly cat here for a night after flying in, then finished the trip home the following day. The staff emailed in English with me in advance and were totally fine watching a senior pet with a chronic condition (something the Haneda airport pet hotel won't do). They let her rest in a quiet place overnight and shared a little report the next day. Really glad to know she was in good hands!

Azabu Pet is the perfect facility for boarding your dog in Tokyo! From my first visit, I felt this was a truly trustworthy place. The staff treated our pet as if it were their own family, and I was deeply moved by their kindness and thoughtfulness.

What impressed me most was the staff's kind and attentive service. They were flexible in accommodating our schedule and requests, allowing us to leave our dog with them with complete peace of mind. Furthermore, the pricing plans are very reasonable, and the wide range of options makes it easy to choose a plan that perfectly suits your needs.

What I was particularly impressed with at Azabu Pet was the wonderful photos they took during our dog's stay! It was a truly joyful experience to see photos of our dog playing with friends and having such a good time. The photos conveyed the fun, almost like they were at a summer camp!

In addition, Azabu Pet offers high-quality grooming services, and I'm looking forward to our dog returning home in the best possible condition. Furthermore, their excellent English support makes it a very attractive option for foreign pet owners and those who wish to use English.

Since using Azabu Pet, I've been so glad I chose this place, seeing how happy my dog ​​is every time. I wholeheartedly recommend this facility to all pet owners living in Japan!
